answers.core: This change would be trivial to add and would make ShapeCasts much smoother to use straight out of the box.
answers.workaround: It wouldn't be worth it compared to just specifying the index as 0 each time. As I mentioned earlier, this is a quality-of-life feature that's meant to let you not have to think about the index unless it's relevant to whatever you're doing.

title: ShapeCast2D & 3D: Collider-Related Functions' 'Index' Parameter Should Default to 0
